sections.title: Study apps
sections.intro: I build these tools alongside my networking, IT support, and algebra coursework. Each runs on its own and saves study progress in the browser.

apps.name: Subnet Sprint
apps.description: Learn subnetting on a guided path: a short lesson for each skill, practice until it sticks, and spaced review. Then work full worksheets, VLSM problems and your weak spots.

apps.name: No Shutdown
apps.description: Learn Cisco IOS one unit at a time: a short lesson, drills until it sticks, then a checkpoint task on a simulated router or switch. Packet Tracer labs and a free sandbox too.

apps.name: Tier One
apps.description: Train for the Windows help desk with lessons, command drills and support tickets. Hints come first, the answer shows after two misses, and missed tickets come back for review.

apps.name: Algebra Workbook
apps.description: Work through college algebra: every lesson ends with a problem to try yourself, then generated practice with hints, spaced flashcards and review by topic.
